title: Bucky Brooks on Broncos free agency: ‘Quality over Quantity’

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Bucky Brooks on Broncos free agency: ‘Quality over Quantity’
sources.description: Bucky Brooks compared Sean Payton’s offseason plan for his team to that of the New York Jets. The difference was stark calling Denver’s plan ‘quality over quantity’ and the Jets as a ‘total makeover’.
